name: MH03b: No. active on ART and  Mental Health treatment during the reporting quarter: Alcohol and Substance use disorder
description:
Number of clients active on ART with either newly identified or known alcohol and substance use disorder who received documented treatment during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have an ART encounter between :startDate and :endDate, satisfy the active-care rule, and have an alcohol_and_substance_use_disorder status indicating treatment. Qualifying states include brief intervention, brief intervention with clinical management, and known alcohol/substance use disorder receiving brief intervention and/or clinical management. Known Alcohol or Substance use disorder NEITHER on Brief Intervention NOR clinical management is excluded because no treatment is documented.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.alcohol_and_substance_use_disorder IN (
      'Has Signs and Symptoms on Brief Intervention',
      'Has Signs and Symptoms on Brief Intervention/clinical management',
      'Known Alcohol or Substance use disorder on Brief Intervention and/or clinical management'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
